'''Yenko Farr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Farr]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3630 BBY]], he and his three sisters answered the call by [[Mandalore the Avenger]] to join the [[Mandalorian clan]]s in the [[raid on Darvannis]]. Yenko Farr and his sisters were in the team led by [[Valk Beroya]] on a mission to disable the factory's northern power generator. Though the mission was a success, Yenko Farr and his three sisters all perished during the fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yenko Farr is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' "Chapter 14: Mandalore the Avenger."<ref name="SWTOR" />
